text:
Mia: Heads up — release notes cutoff for 0.14.2 is in ~3h. Please add entries to release-notes/KEEP.md (use the template). Quick Q: do we require component tags and a visibility field? cc @Omar @Ava

release-bot: Reminder: release-notes cutoff in ~3 hours. Checklist: use template, include PR#, component, type (Added/Changed/Fixed), author. See docs: https://internal/docs/release-notes (automated) :bell:

Omar: Added an entry for PR #4123 but not sure about component mapping — is "serving" vs "runtime" the right label? Where should misc infra changes go?

Simone: runtime -> eng-runtime, serving -> eng-platform. misc infra goes under "platform". Also FYI the template prefers lowercase component names and the canonical verbs: Added / Changed / Fixed (not "Update").

Mia: Good call. Also: do we want a visibility flag (public/internal) so legal/docs can filter?

Jun: We do. Please add `visibility: public` for customer-facing changes. For internal fixes add `visibility: internal` so the public rollup stays clean. I can take backports for small PRs if needed.

Ava: Agree on visibility. Our canonical template has: type, component, pr, author, visibility. If you can't follow the template exactly I'll tidy, but please include the PR link. If you need a manual exception, open a ticket and tag me.

Omar: Sample entry I added (copying here for clarity):
```
- Changed: runtime — reduce KV cache memory during warmup (PR #4123) (@Omar)
  component: runtime
  visibility: public
```

Simone: LGTM. Small style nit: include the full PR link inline if you can, e.g. https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4123 so the release notes renderer can link it automatically.

Mia: I'll do a quick sweep of the release-notes dir and ping owners for entries missing component/visibility. If you get a ping please update within the hour. :pray:

release-bot: Thread labeled release/0.14 and priority set to high (automated).

Ava: Final reminder — cutoff enforced at 17:00 PT. Anything not present by then will be omitted or scheduled for next patch. If you need an exception, open a request and tag @Ava. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
